name: 设置 / 平台 SSH 密钥 / 重新生成、拒绝损坏私钥、导入既有私钥并刷新回读

runtime_evidence.reason: The contract ends at the server's own key pair. No node, sshd, agent, container or GPU is claimed.

crud.create: The server seeds the key pair; UI Rotate creates a replacement through POST /ssh-key/rotate
crud.read: Public key, fingerprint and authorize command are shown; reload and independent GET agree
crud.update: UI Import replaces the key through PUT /ssh-key with an unencrypted OpenSSH private key
crud.delete: N/A: no delete operation; the server keeps one platform key

covered: independent GET sees the new key
confirmation title and rotation impact warning are asserted before accepting
corrupt input rejected with the modal open and no key change
fingerprint and public-key blob match ssh-keygen
GET and the page contain no private-key material
reopening the dialog does not echo the submitted private key
missing: cancel and re-open preserving or clearing a non-submitted draft

covered: rendered after load, rotation and import
missing: that the command actually authorizes the key on a real sshd

checklist_items.1.10: Invalid private-key content is rejected without changing the stored key; the modal remains usable and a later valid import succeeds
checklist_items.1.14: Reload and independent GET preserve the rotated and imported key
checklist_items.7.3: N/A: the private key is supplied by the user, not a one-time plaintext credential issued by the platform
checklist_items.7.6: GET and the page contain no private-key material; the import dialog reopens empty; secret-bearing failures omit screenshots and reports are redacted
checklist_items.12.6: Rejected import preserves the modal and stored key; successful import is independently read back
checklist_items.12.7: N/A: the platform key has no deletion operation; rotation warning text is separately asserted by the case
checklist_items.16.1: N/A: import uses a text area, not a file uploader; malformed and valid key content are exercised through the import form

missing: MISSING: checklist 7.4 (use the imported key for a real allowed operation) — no real sshd or node operation is part of this lane
N/A: checklist 12.8 (delete preview/revision/CAS) — the platform keeps exactly one key and has no delete operation
MISSING: authorizing the new public key on a real sshd and using it for onboarding or recovery
MISSING: encrypted private key rejection and PKCS#8 variants
MISSING: cancel semantics for rotation and a non-submitted import draft
MISSING: non-admin authorization and forbidden rotate/import evidence
MISSING: key persistence across a server restart
MISSING: copy-to-clipboard readback for the public key and authorize command
artifact: secrets/e2e/<runId>/report.json with source/binary/test digests, locale, fingerprints, mutation paths and redacted server log; the generated private key is registered for redaction and removed with its temporary directory
result: NOT_RUN until a matching report.json records PASS with all required evidence, source and binary identity, and private-key cleanup
